title: ARISUN STORM R1 tubeless sealant-leak post (comments reviewed)
notes: Owner thread on a STORM R1 tubeless tire whose cuts from a rough road kept leaking through sealant; the owner later replaced it and preferred a Vittoria tubeless tire. Commenters: one clincher owner reported 8,000 km; one owner moved from the clincher with a TPU tube to the tubeless version and found it comfortable after two weeks; one owner who did not say which version reported cracking from age after seven months. The post year is not shown in the reviewed capture.
